Paragraph: Then those two performed circumambulations to that well glowing ritual fire, and thus, Rama and Sugreeva entered into the pact of friendship.

Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama and Sugreeva circumambulate the fire, solidifying their sacred covenant.
Outcome/Resolution: The alliance is formally and spiritually sealed.
